svg.aria-label: Four 5 by 5 lattices of 25 spins each, with an upward green magnetic field B shown in every panel. Top left: all 25 spins point up, aligned with B, the zero-entropy ground state. Top right: all 25 spins point down, anti-aligned, the zero-entropy fully inverted state. Bottom left: a pseudo-random microstate, 16 up and 9 down. Bottom right: the balanced maximum-entropy state, 13 up and 12 down scrambled, with entropy N k ln 2.
svg.desc: Four spin configurations: all up (ground state), all down (inverted), pseudo-random, and balanced maximum-entropy state.
